theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_cone_estimates
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R → (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), X.support ⊆ closedBall 0 R → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → C ω = X ψ) → C.support ⊆ closedBall 0 R ∧ (X.mass < ∞ → C.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * R) * X.mass)) ∧ (∀ (Xj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m) (Cj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, (Xj j).support ⊆ closedBall 0 R) → X.support ⊆ closedBall 0 R → (∀ j, (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ (Xj j).support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → (Cj j) ω = (Xj j) ψ)) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → C ω = X ψ) → WeaklyConvergesOn Xj X → WeaklyConvergesOn Cj C)
